purpose: First bounded offline comparison of statistical, geometric and self-organizing representations of one full16 current-state posterior message.
adaptation: The geometric arm is a normalized probability atlas, not the previously proposed likelihood atlas. This makes all three arms compare the same existing current-state posterior. Likelihood transport and causal rolling integration are not implemented here.
source_selection: Sort the four population_n4096_seed*.npz files. Construct from first two; evaluate on last two independently. Use projected[:, :16] only. No truth reads or inference reruns.
reference_limit: Existing finite moment checks, not validated coverage or an exact reference density. Particles within a population are dependent. Independent population differences are descriptive, not IID standard errors.
common_support: Public static/health bounds; current SOC [0,1], RC voltages [-0.25,0.25], hysteresis [-1,1]. No clipping; numerical endpoints explicitly unavailable.
mixture: Fixed equal-width normalized logQ bins choose construction membership. Each region fits a full16 Gaussian in global bounded-logit coordinates. Its density has global support; mixture weights are regional sample mass. No EM or covariance shrinkage.
atlas: Disjoint normalized logQ intervals. Within each interval t in [-1,1] has maximum-entropy quadratic density exp(theta1*t+theta2*t*t)/Z. The remaining15 global logits have Gaussian conditional mean a+B*t and full15 residual covariance. Chart masses sum to one. Jacobians included.
adaptive: Same atlas density and node count. A restricted self-organizing chain: 16 Lloyd passes on normalized logQ, starting equal-width centers; boundaries are center midpoints with fixed support endpoints. No forgetting, deletion, reseeding or truth-based tuning. This tests scalar placement, not a full16 neural gas.
assessment: Held-out physical-coordinate log predictive density per independent population; relative scores only, not absolute KL or a universal NLL cutoff
All16 means, covariance, 5/50/95 quantiles; current Q/SOC/R0 marginals and fixed future voltage predictive distributions
Current terminal-voltage distribution, candidate-vs-reference spread; retain correlations and weak directions
Explicit physical support loss in future probes without discarding or renormalizing invalid mass
Packed retained numeric payload, construction lower bound, process peak RSS and host CPU; no Cortex-M23 claim
ownership: Each representation owns the initial prior and the same [0,prefix) observation/transition intervals once. Regions are alternatives, never independent evidence. Offline refitting uses source samples and is not an online update algebra.
controls: sample replication does not shrink posterior uncertainty
unsupported inputs and singular factors fail explicitly
physical probe parity with qualified scalar kernel
failure_policy: Record per-case failures and continue the census. Do not relax numerical settings or tune on held-out samples after observing outcomes.
four_hour_gate: Requires causal posterior ownership/update and physical health transport, adequate representation and complete SRAM/update qualification. Offline snapshots alone cannot satisfy this gate.
